description: Bounded semantic mutations for recursive BBS auxiliary export, archive path mapping, and SkipAuxiliary behavior.

mutants.description: Directory entries must be queued for traversal; treating them as files skips the nested auxiliary payloads without introducing an unbounded loop.
Normal auxiliary files are exported when SkipAuxiliary is absent; inverting the gate must remove both exact payloads while leaving the sibling control outside the root.
Files rooted in the model auxiliary directory must retain the Auxiliaries/ archive prefix; a wrong prefix makes both exact archive-path checks fail.
